fusions.name: Unhurried Throw
fusions.desc: Lobs a heavy, slow point that deals 14 water damage to the first enemy it meets, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Swell of the Tide
fusions.desc: Turns the shaft in a slow circle, dealing 26 water damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. On a hit, every ally near you deals 15% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Is Urgent
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds, with a 100% chance to leave each enemy [Slowed] for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Drifting Mend
fusions.desc: When you take non-fire damage, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
